commonWebRules.authority: Q24 bounded definitions after workbook, merged object fields, exact literal/FourCC script search and primary descriptions; native client not available
reused: area-damage-v1 geometry/snapshot pattern only; each family retains its explicit mask

activeCast.accept: exists alive enabled level1, not active cast lock (stun/hex/silence/pause), cooldown exactly0, enough explicit mana, finite target in range if targeted; source invulnerability/Aloc allowed
activeCast.windup: unit castpt: centaur/bear/reaver.5s, predator.75s; q001 missing castpt => scoped0. Attack speed does not scale castpt. Source movement/order/lock/death cancels uncommitted cast without cost/cooldown
activeCast.commit: recheck source state/ability/cooldown/mana; deduct once and set cooldown; one AnySkillStart SPELL_EFFECT then native payload; direct event handler killed/removed source cancels payload without refund; missing target after accepted nonhoming aim does not cancel point payload
activeCast.simultaneous: zero windup queues B05 after current synchronous stack; no arbitrary inline effect before existing script after-order writes
activeCast.autocast: reuse 6 exact branches/shortcircuit and original overall priorities; unsuccessful issued order still ends scan; ready helper itself is not native acceptance
activeCast.fail: no cost/cooldown/SPELL_EFFECT/native effect on rejected order
activeCast.statusTypes: ground/air is effective target classification (UnitData.targType/current native type), not movetp string; many wave monsters move as fly but target ground
activeCast.sameOrder: if multiple family IDs artificially coexist choose earliest ready attached ID in family ascending ID; native alias resolution unproved; ordinary towers have only one
activeCast.controlTiming: duration integer microseconds B05; all damage through independent B03 context; nested state changes remain live; no blanket disabling equipment/skill procs

commonWebRules.hiddenTargets: native hidden units excluded from family effects; ordinary invisible units can be affected by untargeted area effects, whereas direct targeting/secondary arrows require current player visibility
commonWebRules.sourceNotDefaults: Absent fields remain absent in sourceFields. Every chosen missing native default belongs to Q24 sections.

rules.packet: add bonus to one committed ordinary attack raw amount; keep actual source, original attackType, attack=true, damageType=NORMAL

Q24.manualOrder: one next ordinary attack at target, subject to range/attack readiness
Q24.manualSpellEffect: one at committed arrow before damage; auto arrows emit none
Q24.snapshot: bonus/toggle at attack commit; toggling later does not change projectile
Q24.projectile: speed1500 homing, locked target handle; normal attack arrival/hit qualification, no second missile
Q24.targets: current ordinary-attack legal visible enemy ground/air/structure; no Aloc/invulnerability/ethereal; magic immunity allowed
Q24.miss: normal attack hit check; miss gives no bonus, no extra guaranteed hit
Q24.illusion: no bonus and no manual orb cast
Q24.stack: one strongest active N001/N002, no two bonuses; choose lower rawcode on tie
Q24.unknown: Cost absent is not source zero; no stock AHfa 8-mana inheritance claimed

Q24.roll: one independent uniform integer1..100<=30 after successful ordinary attack hit qualification, before packet; no roll on miss/nonattack/air/illusion/dead/invulnerable/ethereal target
Q24.targets: enemy ground units; magic immune permitted; mechanical/structure may take bonus but receive no stun
Q24.packet: bonus added to same ordinary NORMAL attack, no extra event; preserve attack/ranged/attackType/source
Q24.stunOrder: apply before packet; target death clears it
Q24.heroSelector: native HERO or effective Arsk; not UnitIsHero or SAPPER alone
Q24.buffFamily: local bash/stomp BPSE control uses latest-max-expiry, independent from other control families
Q24.remove: death/removal/explicit BPSE remove/expiry; ordinary magic dispel does not remove; silence does not disable this passive
Q24.missingFields: DataB multiplier=>1, DataD miss=>0, DataE neverMiss=>false are explicit Web defaults, no native inference
Q24.stack: highest bonus among N003–5; one roll, one stun; no duration summation

Q24.targets: enemy ground units incl structures/mechanical for damage; no air/Aloc/invulnerable/magicImmune; stunned only organic nonstructure without explicit stun immunity
Q24.control: stun before per-target damage, same local BPSE max-expiry family as bash; heroSelector native HERO or effective Arsk
Q24.sourceLife: source must exist/alive through emission; removed mid synchronous children stops remaining
Q24.shield: point/immediate area does not consume N535

Q24.cap: total includes primary; choose at most total-1 unique secondary targets
Q24.center: tower at attack commit, closed1000 radius
Q24.secondaryOrder: B04 stable creation order; exclude primary, no nearest heuristic
Q24.trigger: ordinary attack always retains primary; if local multishot cooldown ready, launch secondary volley and set readyAt=commitTime+2s, including when no secondary targets; nonready attacks have primary only
